alt:/figures/health/risk-matrix.png|The Risk Management Matrix: a four-box grid with incident cost on the vertical axis and probability, frequency, or occurrence on the horizontal. Box 1, low cost and low frequency, is retain — ignore it. Box 2, high cost and low frequency, is transfer — insure and manage cost; it is labeled The Insurance Quadrant. Box 3, low cost and high frequency, is retain — self-insure and manage frequency; insuring here is marked inappropriate and flagged DANGER: potential for administrative cost explosion. Box 4, high cost and high frequency, is avoid — eliminate the risky behavior.
